name: ServiceGraph API
description: Search the ServiceGraph catalog of US professional-services firms. Anonymous /v1/search (IP-rate-limited) returns brief firm cards. Authenticate with email + OTP (free) for full /v1/get/{apex} data. Quota-exhausted authed callers fall back to the anon shape with `quota_exceeded: true`.
